portal: rrbapply.gov.in and the website of your RRB
sources: RRB notices and candidate login pages as seen in the CEN 09/2025 cycle

admitCard.where: Candidate login on the application portal named in the notice (rrbapply.gov.in in the 2026 cycle) and the website of your RRB
admitCard.when: Exam city and date slip from about 10 days before the exam, e-call letter from about 4 days before your own date, released on a rolling basis (CEN 09/2025)
steps: Open the website of the RRB you applied to, or the candidate login the notice names, and sign in with your registration number and date of birth or password.
The exam city and date slip comes first, about 10 days before the exam in the 2026 Group D cycle. It is only for travel planning and is not an entry pass.
The e-call letter (admit card) follows about 4 days before your own date, on a rolling basis for each day's candidates.
Download the e-call letter, print it, and check the shift, reporting time, centre address and photo.
carry: The original ID proof named in the instructions
Only what the e-call letter allows. Phones, calculators and other devices are not allowed inside the hall
admitCard.note: The PET has its own call letter, released after the CBT result. Keep your phone number and email active.

answerKey.summary: The RRBs publish the question paper, the answer key and your response sheet after the exam, with a window to raise objections online.
steps: Use the link in the RRB notice and sign in with your registration number and date of birth.
Open your response sheet and compare each answer with the provisional key.
To object, select the question, upload proof if the form asks for it, and pay the fee online before the last date.
The RRB decides on the objections and uses the revised key to prepare the result. It does not reply to each objection.
answerKey.fee: In recent RRB NTPC notices the objection fee was 50 rupees per question plus bank charges, refunded after the bank charges if the objection is accepted. Confirm the amount in your own notice.
answerKey.note: The result uses normalised marks across shifts, so do not expect the raw score from the key to match the scorecard.

result.summary: Each RRB publishes the CBT result as a PDF of roll numbers and the scores through the candidate login.

stages.what: Shortlist for the physical efficiency test at about three times the vacancies, category-wise and RRB-wise.
Physical test, qualifying only. Candidates called for document verification are taken in merit order.
Final stage, at about one time the vacancies, followed by medical examination for the post.

result.scorecard: The scorecard shows your marks and normalised marks. Download it when the link opens.
